twinleaf-town.name: Twinleaf Town
twinleaf-town.description: Start beside the flower beds. Take the north path to Route 201.

route-201.name: Route 201
route-201.description: Follow the grassland trail to Sandgem Town or head west to Lake Verity.

verity-lakefront.name: Lake Verity
verity-lakefront.description: Search the reeds along the quiet shore west of Route 201.

sandgem-town.name: Sandgem Town
sandgem-town.description: A small coastal town with a PC. Route 202 leaves to the north.

route-202.name: Route 202
route-202.description: Tall grass lines the road between Sandgem and Jubilife.

jubilife-city.name: Jubilife City
jubilife-city.description: Use the PC before taking Route 203 east or Route 204 north.

route-203.name: Route 203
route-203.description: A pond and grassy banks sit west of the Oreburgh Gate entrance.

oreburgh-gate.name: Oreburgh Gate
oreburgh-gate.description: Cross the rocky passage between Route 203 and Oreburgh City.

oreburgh-city.name: Oreburgh City
oreburgh-city.description: The mining town has a PC and a northern trail toward Mount Coronet.

route-204.name: Route 204
route-204.description: Search the grassy banks on the way north to Floaroma Town.

floaroma-town.name: Floaroma Town
floaroma-town.description: Stop at the PC between the flower fields. Head north to Eterna Forest or east to Valley Windworks.

valley-windworks.name: Valley Windworks
valley-windworks.description: Search the tall grass between the turbine yard and the river.

eterna-forest.name: Eterna Forest
eterna-forest.description: Look for wild Pokémon in the clearings between the trees.

eterna-city.name: Eterna City
eterna-city.description: Visit the PC between Eterna Forest and Mount Coronet.

mt-coronet.name: Mount Coronet
mt-coronet.description: Climb through the mountain to Lake Acuity or return to Eterna or Oreburgh.

acuity-lakefront.name: Lake Acuity
acuity-lakefront.description: Slide across the frozen shore and search the snowdrifts for wild Pokémon.
